activity_statements.statement: designs, engineers, and manufactures passenger cars, trucks, SUVs, and vans under the Chevrolet, GMC, Cadillac, and Buick brands for the U.S. and global markets
develops battery materials, electric vehicle powertrains, and software-defined vehicle technology for its EV portfolio including the Cadillac Lyriq and multiple Ultium-platform vehicles
operates OnStar connected vehicle services (telematics, emergency response, navigation) for its vehicle fleet customers
provides auto financing and leasing through GM Financial to retail consumers and commercial fleet customers
operates 150+ manufacturing and assembly facilities employing 90,000+ people across the Americas and internationally

name_reality_gap: none — General Motors correctly signals a major motor vehicle manufacturer, though the growing software-defined vehicle and EV technology investment means it increasingly operates as a technology developer alongside its manufacturing role.
extraction_notes: Good about page with concrete employee/facility data. Software-defined vehicle technology and EV investment explicitly named on the page. GM Financial and OnStar are well-documented public subsidiaries.
